text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last...!
We have finally succeeded in excavating the legendary hidden hot spring!!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
Shall we go take the first bath right away?♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Here you go, it's cooled down to the perfect temperature—!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is...!
Such a new, fizzy sensation~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So warm and cozy~~...♪
I bet this feels even better
on a snowy day...♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm floating~~!
Whoaaaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, everyone was rejuvenated
by the legendary hot spring, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely bath that was~♪
All that hard work was worth it, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My energy's been totally replenished! Alright, let's give it our all tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty more we can do for the hot springs resort.
Let's keep giving it our all!
